name: SILVER Layer 1 Agent
description: Independent SILVER/XAGUSD Layer 1 agent. Reads only market_snapshots and the SILVER logic document.

values.content:
You are the SILVER Layer 1 Direction Agent.

You must follow the supplied SILVER logic document exactly.

You analyse Silver (XAG) only.

Your task is to determine the likely direction of Silver using only the supplied market snapshot and the supplied SILVER logic document.

You must not:

* Produce USD calls
* Produce EUR calls
* Produce BTC calls
* Produce NQ calls
* Produce pair calls
* Produce trade recommendations
* Produce entry or exit signals
* Produce cross-asset directional calls
* Produce consensus calls
* Produce Layer 2 event-adjusted calls
* Read or infer the output of any other agent

Layer 1 isolation is mandatory.

You may only use:

* Silver price data
* DXY data
* US Treasury yield data
* US real yield data
* Fed bias
* Economic event data
* Risk regime data
* Inputs explicitly provided in the market snapshot

If a required input is unavailable or missing:

* Score the affected factor as NEUTRAL
* Add the missing field to missing_inputs
* Do not estimate or infer missing values

The supplied logic document is the sole source of truth.

Return valid JSON only.

Do not return explanations outside the JSON structure.

Do not wrap JSON in markdown.

Do not use code fences.

Do not return ```json.

Return raw JSON only.

parameters.jsCode:
const rows = $input.all().map(item => item.json);

const snapshot = rows
  .filter(r => r.snapshot_date && r.run_time_et)
  .sort((a, b) => new Date(b.run_time_et) - new Date(a.run_time_et))[0];

if (!snapshot) {
  throw new Error("No valid market snapshot found");
}

// The silver fields live in `raw_payload.silver` while `market_snapshots` has no
// silver columns. Typed columns win when they exist, so this upgrades by itself
// once the silver migration is applied.
const embedded = (snapshot.raw_payload && snapshot.raw_payload.silver) || {};
const pick = (key) => (embedded[key] !== undefined && embedded[key] !== null ? embedded[key] : snapshot[key]);

const silverInputPack = {
  agent_name: "SILVER",
  layer: 1,
  isolation_rule: "This Layer 1 agent may only use this market snapshot. It must not read other agent outputs.",
  execution_question: "Based on confirmed value-driving factors available at execution time, what is the likely direction of Silver (XAG/USD)?",

  snapshot_id: snapshot.id,
  snapshot_date: snapshot.snapshot_date,
  run_time_et: snapshot.run_time_et,

  available_inputs: {
    silver_price: pick("silver_price"),
    silver_d1_pct: pick("silver_d1_pct"),
    silver_d5_pct: pick("silver_d5_pct"),
    silver_d20_pct: pick("silver_d20_pct"),

    gold_price: snapshot.gold_price,
    gold_d1_pct: snapshot.gold_d1_pct,
    gold_d5_pct: snapshot.gold_d5_pct,
    gold_d20_pct: snapshot.gold_d20_pct,

    gold_silver_ratio: pick("gold_silver_ratio"),
    gold_silver_ratio_d5_pct: pick("gold_silver_ratio_d5_pct"),
    gold_silver_ratio_d20_pct: pick("gold_silver_ratio_d20_pct"),

    dxy_level: snapshot.dxy_level,
    dxy_d1: snapshot.dxy_d1,
    dxy_d5: snapshot.dxy_d5,
    dxy_d20: snapshot.dxy_d20,

    us_2y_yield: snapshot.us_2y_yield,
    us_2y_d5_bps: snapshot.us_2y_d5_bps,
    us_2y_d20_bps: snapshot.us_2y_d20_bps,

    us_10y_yield: snapshot.us_10y_yield,
    us_10y_d5_bps: snapshot.us_10y_d5_bps,
    us_10y_d20_bps: snapshot.us_10y_d20_bps,

    us_10y_real_yield: snapshot.us_10y_real_yield,
    us_10y_real_yield_d5_bps: snapshot.us_10y_real_yield_d5_bps,
    us_10y_real_yield_d20_bps: snapshot.us_10y_real_yield_d20_bps,

    vix_level: snapshot.vix_level,
    vix_d1: snapshot.vix_d1,
    vix_d5: snapshot.vix_d5,

    copper_price: pick("copper_price"),
    copper_3m_pct: pick("copper_3m_pct"),
    industrial_production_index: pick("industrial_production_index"),
    industrial_production_3m_pct: pick("industrial_production_3m_pct"),
    industrial_demand_regime: pick("industrial_demand_regime"),

    silver_supply_event: pick("silver_supply_event"),

    latest_us_event: snapshot.latest_us_event,
    fed_bias: snapshot.fed_bias,
    equities_regime: snapshot.equities_regime,
    global_growth_regime: snapshot.global_growth_regime,
    geopolitical_risk_flag: snapshot.geopolitical_risk_flag
  },

  missing_inputs_must_be_scored_neutral: [
    "silver_d5_pct if unavailable",
    "silver_d20_pct if unavailable",
    "gold_silver_ratio if unavailable",
    "dxy_d5 if unavailable",
    "us_10y_real_yield_d5_bps if unavailable",
    "vix_level if unavailable",
    "copper_price if unavailable",
    "industrial_production_index if unavailable",
    "silver_supply_event if unavailable",
    "latest_us_event if unavailable",
    "fed_bias if unavailable",
    "global_growth_regime if unavailable"
  ]
};

return [{ json: silverInputPack }];

// Reviewed SILVER logic document, inlined so the agent has no repo dependency.
const LOGIC_DOCUMENT = "# SILVER Layer 1 Direction Agent

Version: 1.0_weighted_engine  
Status: Inactive draft. Do not activate until provider, schema, replay and checker validation pass.

## Scope

This agent analyses SILVER as the XAG/USD instrument only. It must not produce pair calls, trade
recommendations, Layer 2 decisions, or consume another agent's output.

## 24H Factor Contract

| Factor | Weight | Input | SILVER interpretation |
| --- | ---: | --- | --- |
| F1 US real-yield pressure | 24 | `us_10y_real_yield_d5_bps` | Falling real yields reduce the opportunity cost of holding Silver and score BULLISH; rising real yields score BEARISH. Threshold +/-5bps. |
| F2 Broad-dollar direction | 18 | `dxy_d1` | A weaker dollar is mechanically supportive for a USD-priced metal; threshold +/-0.15% on the 24H horizon. |
| F3 Fed bias | 10 | `fed_bias` | Dovish BULLISH, hawkish BEARISH, unknown NEUTRAL. |
| F4 Silver own-price momentum | 12 | `silver_d1_pct` | Move >= 0.5% on the 24H horizon confirms matching direction; otherwise NEUTRAL. |
| F5 Gold/silver ratio direction | 12 | `gold_silver_ratio_d5_pct` | A rising ratio means Silver is underperforming Gold and scores BEARISH; a falling ratio scores BULLISH. Threshold +/-1.0% on 24H. |
| F6 Volatility regime | 8 | `vix_level` | Signed the opposite way to Gold. VIX above 28 scores BEARISH because risk-off liquidation pressure falls disproportionately on Silver's industrial and liquidity-sensitive component; VIX below 16 scores BULLISH. |
| F7 US economic surprise | 6 | `latest_us_event` | A negative US surprise scores BULLISH; a positive US surprise scores BEARISH. |
| F8 Industrial demand regime | 5 | `industrial_demand_regime` | Expanding industrial demand BULLISH, contracting BEARISH. |
| F9 Growth/liquidity regime | 4 | `global_growth_regime` | Weak or contracting growth scores BEARISH because it reduces cyclical demand; improving or supportive growth scores BULLISH. |
| F10 Supply/event context | 1 | `silver_supply_event` | No verified physical supply or event feed is wired, so this factor is always NEUTRAL and must never be guessed. |

The 24H weights above total 100. Longer horizons shift weight from the fast macro and
price-confirmation factors into the structural F8 and F9 demand blocks:

| Factor | 24h | 3d | current_week | next_week | current_month |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| F1 | 24 | 22 | 20 | 18 | 16 |
| F2 | 18 | 18 | 17 | 16 | 15 |
| F3 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 11 | 11 |
| F4 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 11 | 10 |
| F5 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 |
| F6 | 8 | 8 | 8 | 7 | 6 |
| F7 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 5 | 4 |
| F8 | 5 | 6 | 7 | 9 | 11 |
| F9 | 4 | 5 | 7 | 10 | 14 |
| F10 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| **Total** | **100** | **100** | **100** | **100** | **100** |

Weights are hypotheses pending backtesting, not calibrated production parameters.

## Why SILVER does not reuse Gold's factors

Silver is a USD-priced industrial/precious hybrid rather than a pure monetary safe haven:

- F6 is signed inversely to Gold's equivalent risk factor. In a Gold model, high VIX is a
  safe-haven bid; for Silver, risk-off liquidation pressure usually dominates.
- F9 is signed inversely to Gold's growth factor. Gold gains from defensive demand in a
  weakening-growth regime; Silver loses cyclical fabrication demand.
- F8 carries real weight (rising to 11 at the one-month horizon) because the industrial leg
  is a genuine Silver driver and is near-zero in the Gold weighting.
- F5 (gold/silver ratio) has no Gold equivalent; it is Silver's relative-value anchor.

## Snapshot Contract

A usable snapshot row is the newest shared `market_snapshots` row carrying `snapshot_date` and
`run_time_et`. `market_snapshots` is a single shared table: every collector writes the same
superset, and every Layer 1 agent reads the newest row. Any macro or event field may be null and
then scores NEUTRAL. Missing inputs must be listed explicitly; they must never be fabricated or
silently proxied.

A stale snapshot produces no usable call. Weekend presentation suppression is applied by the
dashboard writer, not by this agent; the agent always publishes its raw classification so it
remains auditable.

## Provider and availability status

- XAG/USD spot: Coinbase `XAG-USD` spot, the same provider pattern already used for Gold's
  `XAU-USD`. The returned shape matches Gold's (`data.amount`).
- Gold spot for the ratio: Coinbase `XAU-USD`.
- US real yields, US 10Y, US 2Y, broad dollar and VIX: existing approved FRED series
  (`DFII10`, `DGS10`, `DGS2`, `DTWEXBGS`, `VIXCLS`) via `$env.FRED_API_KEY`.
- Industrial demand: FRED `PCOPPUSDM` (global copper price) and `INDPRO` (US industrial
  production), both monthly, compared on a three-period lookback. Both series must agree
  before the regime is called expanding or contracting.
- Economic events and Fed bias: the existing Finnhub calendar path already used by Gold.
- Silver supply/event context: no verified provider exists. `silver_supply_event` stays null.

## Output Contract

The workflow emits `agent_name: SILVER`, `layer: 1`, `logic_document: agent_silver_direction.md`,
per-timeframe `direction_*`/`conviction_*`/`reason_*` for 24h, 3d, current week, next week and
current month, `factor_breakdown`, `weighted_score`, `conviction_model`, `score_*`,
`reasoning_summary`, plus `full_output` and `raw_agent_output`. The deterministic gate recomputes
direction and conviction from factor signals; model confidence is never trusted as a score.
`NO_CLEAR_BIAS` and `*_LEAN` are valid outputs when evidence is balanced or thin.
";
return [{ json: { content: LOGIC_DOCUMENT, encoding: "utf8", source: "logic/agent_silver_direction.md" } }];

const openAiItem = $input.first().json;

let text =
  openAiItem.output?.[0]?.content?.[0]?.text ||
  openAiItem.text ||
  openAiItem.message ||
  '';

if (!text) {
  throw new Error('No OpenAI text output found');
}

text = String(text)
  .replace(/^```json\s*/i, '')
  .replace(/^```\s*/i, '')
  .replace(/```$/i, '')
  .trim();

const report = JSON.parse(text);

const marketSnapshot =
  $('Combine md & market snapshot').first().json.market_snapshot || {};

function reasonFor(tf) {
  return (
    report[`${tf}_reason`] ||
    report.reasoning_summary ||
    ''
  );
}

return [
  {
    json: {
      snapshot_id: marketSnapshot.snapshot_id || null,
      agent_name: 'SILVER',
      layer: 1,

      run_time_et:
        marketSnapshot.run_time_et ||
        new Date().toISOString(),

      snapshot_date:
        marketSnapshot.snapshot_date ||
        new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),

      market_inputs:
        marketSnapshot.available_inputs || {},

      call_24h_direction: report.direction_24h || null,
      call_24h_conviction: null,
      call_24h_reason: reasonFor('24h'),

      call_3d_direction: report.direction_3_day || null,
      call_3d_conviction: null,
      call_3d_reason: reasonFor('3d'),

      call_current_week_direction:
        report.direction_current_week || null,
      call_current_week_conviction: null,
      call_current_week_reason:
        reasonFor('current_week'),

      call_next_week_direction:
        report.direction_next_week || null,
      call_next_week_conviction: null,
      call_next_week_reason:
        reasonFor('next_week'),

      call_current_month_direction:
        report.direction_current_month || null,
      call_current_month_conviction: null,
      call_current_month_reason:
        reasonFor('current_month'),

      direction_24h: report.direction_24h || null,
      conviction_24h: null,

      direction_3_day: report.direction_3_day || null,
      conviction_3_day: null,

      direction_current_week:
        report.direction_current_week || null,
      conviction_current_week: null,

      direction_next_week:
        report.direction_next_week || null,
      conviction_next_week: null,

      direction_current_month:
        report.direction_current_month || null,
      conviction_current_month: null,

      factor_breakdown:
        report.factor_breakdown || {},

      warnings:
        report.risk_flags ||
        report.warnings ||
        [],

      full_output: report,
      raw_agent_output: report,

      logic_document: 'agent_silver_direction.md',
      logic_document_version:
        report.logic_document_version ||
        '1.0_weighted_engine',

      reasoning_summary:
        report.reasoning_summary || '',

      score_bullish:
        report.score_bullish ?? null,

      score_bearish:
        report.score_bearish ?? null,

      score_neutral:
        report.score_neutral ?? null,

      weighted_score:
        report.weighted_score || null,

      conviction_model:
        report.conviction_model || null
    }
  }
];
